acquisition: Operator binds a tenant and stored version to an approved ERDDAP host/dataset. Worker verifies exact metadata response digest, native measurement definition/units/dimension order, CSV coordinates/time/units and rectangular response shape. Points and rectangular polygons only, at most 2 degrees per spatial axis, 31 days, 100000 response rows and 8 MiB per response. Source nearest-coordinate rounding outside the requested domain is rejected; requests may need narrower aligned bounds. Metadata drift requires a newly registered version, never silent substitution.
sst_semantics: Foundation SST is a distinct standard_name; degree_C is retained as a native unit spelling. This does not assert compatibility with skin/bulk SST or accept MUR as the scientific baseline.
cloud_storage: Exact-byte SHA256 keys under snapshots/{tenant}/sha256/{hash}. Existing objects and new uploads are read back and compared byte-for-byte. S3 metadata and ETags are not trusted as byte verification. No native versioning/object-lock guarantees are claimed; IAM must restrict external mutation. A crash may leave unreferenced bytes. Automatic orphan deletion is not implemented.
runtime: python -m orca.worker --tenant UUID processes one request, --watch polls. API and worker require the same approved source bindings. ORCA_ACQUISITION_ENABLED defaults false. The flag is an operator deployment acknowledgement, not a worker heartbeat. Production deployment and credentials were not changed.
fitness_contract_reconciliation: version_ref and baseline_ref are stored version UUIDs. products is a bounded list of stored version UUIDs, not unversioned products. Explicit organization_id resolves tenant membership. Reports contain per-check pass/fail/unknown results and remain scientifically not_validated. Unknown method/QC/baseline evidence prevents an overall compatible status. These are metadata checks, not P04 method execution.
validation_policy: User requested larger deliveries and allowed some tests to be deferred. Keep lint/type/contracts, affected security/isolation and regression checks. Do not represent unexecuted live source, Supabase deployment, stress or scientific checks as passed. G03 remains incomplete.
